data.name: Ayandeep
data.gender_notes: Ayandeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayan means 'moving' or 'moving towards' and Deep means 'ocean' or 'deep'. So Ayandeep can be interpreted as 'moving towards the deep ocean' or 'one who is moving towards the ocean of knowledge'. It is also a name for Lord Vishnu. The name Ayandeep carries the meaning “Deep, Ocean of Illumination” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ayandeep usually hope their child will grow to embody deep, ocean of illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayandeep total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
